name: Stage 43: Skyrshyttan to Sandstugan
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 43, Skyrshyttan to Sandstugan.
utilities: Skyrshyttan is a weak car-access start: official text says there is no good parking at the stage start, perhaps only room for one roadside car.

Official start access is by bus from Nyköping/Nyköpings busstation to Munksäter/Munksätter, then about 15 minutes walking to Skyrshyttan. GTFS/OpenStreetMap spell the operational stop Munksätter; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken because rural service can be sparse.

Sandstugan has a bus stop essentially at the endpoint, but official stage 44 says there is no parking at Sandstugan. Svalstaskogen reserve parking about 1 km beyond Sandstugan is the practical mapped parking context if continuing or staging nearby.

Skyrshyttan-side access is on line 561, while Sandstugan-side access is listed on line 663 in GTFS-based data. A pure public-transport end-to-end day may require careful timing or transfer via Nyköping.
No verified toilet, shelter, campsite, grill/fireplace, shop, cafe, restaurant, or potable-water service was found directly on stage 43.
waterSources: No verified potable water, tap, spring, lake refill, or dependable natural source was found on stage 43. Carry water.
Do not attach stage 44 water points to stage 43 except as onward-planning context.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden and the 2025 long-distance passport list stage 43 as 6 km, while Naturkartan shows 5.9 km/5863 m, OSM relation 6575005 measures about 5.95 km despite a stale 5 km distance tag, Äventyrligare lists 5.8 km, and the local app GeoJSON measures about 5.77 km. AllTrails' roughly 4.7 km and Nya Stigar's 5.0 km values appear to be lower-confidence simplified/older logs.

Main-route topology runs from stage 42 at Skyrshyttan to stage 44 at Sandstugan. For route-builder stitching, snap to the OSM topology join at 58.676255,16.886758 for Skyrshyttan and 58.703434,16.874178 for Sandstugan; the local official-GPX drawing is close enough for display, with endpoint gaps around 20-40 m.

Stage 43 is easy/green but very service-light and not very wilderness-like as a standalone hike. Expect transport-style walking: old railway embankments, old spruce-plantation/clearcut areas, roughly 2 km forest road, roughly 2 km gravel road from Månstorp, and asphalt into Sandstugan.
The official page showed no current reported faults during the 2026-04-27 pass. Keep any older route-condition reports as historical caveats unless a current source confirms them.

Skyrshyttan has medieval iron/mining context and sits in the wider Tunaberg hytta/mining landscape, but official text says only scattered remains of a medieval bondehytta are visible. Treat remains as look-but-do-not-disturb cultural heritage.

A Team Vildmark report for stages 42/43 supports the practical character: varied forest, paths, gravel roads, old crofts/mining areas, giant's kettles, old railway bed, and final asphalt toward Sandstugan. Their mention of a homemade shelter should not be promoted as an official shelter or dependable rest resource.

A Nya Stigar 2015 note about dumped stone/aggregate near the Skyrshyttan-side end is historical only; no current confirmation was found and the official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass.
No stage-43-specific reserve restriction was found. Nearby Svalstaskogen rules belong primarily to stage 44 context, but matter if continuing beyond Sandstugan.

If continuing into Svalstaskogen on stage 44, reserve rules include no damaging living/dead trees, limited collection only of ordinary berries/edible mushrooms/personal flowers, organized camps require permission, and fires require bringing your own wood. Länsstyrelsen also warns about bark-beetle-damaged spruce/falling trees there, and stage 44 has a post-Sandstugan reroute for bark-beetle damage.
Check current Nyköping/Sörmlandskusten fire-ban status before using any fire on nearby stages; stricter fire bans can prohibit fixed grill places.
